text: We are Team Hardcoder, and this is TidePlan: repayment, in rhythm with life. A borrower can have enough income over a season, yet struggle with the same payment every month. We help lenders understand that difference.

Meet Asha, a smallholder farmer. Her income follows harvest cycles. TidePlan protects essentials, existing debt, and a chosen safety buffer. Here, the same eighteen thousand rupees is scheduled, while months below the protected buffer fall from two to zero.

Different livelihoods need different conversations. Meera has a shop with changing demand. Ravi shows three months of sustained decline against the previous year. The system flags that change instead of assuming every downturn is seasonal.

In Plan studio, adjust the safety buffer and model an income shock. The chart recalculates immediately. Conservative income gets a fifteen percent haircut before any repayment is allocated. Every assumption is visible, not hidden inside a score.

A severe shock exposes the limit. TidePlan shows what cannot be scheduled and blocks approval. Rescheduling cannot create money. This is a signal for a human review, additional support, or a separately assessed change in terms.

Return to a manageable scenario. Compare the fixed and aligned plans, then inspect every monthly payment. Export the schedule, or import your own synthetic monthly records. The engine preserves exact totals and never exceeds available repayment capacity.

The lender approves a specific scenario. The borrower then reviews the amounts and explicitly accepts. Changing the data or assumptions requires a new approval. This prototype demonstrates the workflow; these role buttons are not production authentication.

The trust view records both decisions. A reviewed shock scenario can receive simulated sponsor support from a resilience reserve. This grant uses demo units only. No real money moves, and the displayed loan schedule is not silently changed.

Each event links to the previous event through a cryptographic hash. Verify the chain, inspect the evidence, or deliberately test a modified copy. Tampering is detected. Independent blockchain assurance is a future integration, not a claim about browser storage.

React and TypeScript power the interface and calculations. The repository includes separate Hyperledger Fabric and reserve contract blueprints. TidePlan supports financial inclusion under Sustainable Development Goal eight: a clearer repayment decision, with the borrower still in control.
